description: Italian ground stations (communication) and optical telescopes STAR can use, 2026-10-17. END-001 takes the communication station(s) for contacts, data latency and ground-station access (and END-004 its contact duty cycles); the optical telescope is the observer of the first night pass END-010 simulates. A station named in the mission request, or given as STAR input ground_stations / observatory, is used; otherwise STAR chooses (runners/star_ground_stations.py): the communication station nearest to the area of interest among those supporting the downlink band of the CubeSat radios, and the telescope with the most convenient first night pass (END-001 select_downstream_passes, LightCurve.Candidates). Coordinates in degrees, altitude in metres above sea level, mask = minimum elevation in degrees. coordinates_basis: 'source' = coordinates of the cited page, 'locality' = coordinates of the locality named by the source (the antennas are within a few km). status_evidence quotes what the sources say; nothing here was verified on site.

communication.name: Matera - ASI Centro di Geodesia Spaziale 'G. Colombo'
communication.bands_basis: Earth-observation data reception, strongly active in COSMO-SkyMed (X-band downlink)
communication.status_evidence: Wikipedia: about 100 people work at the centre, in operation since 1983, part of the international laser ranging services, strongly active in COSMO-SkyMed
communication.note: The END-001 template station 'Matera' had longitude 16.5528 deg (about 13 km west of the centre); STAR uses these coordinates.

communication.name: Fucino - Telespazio Space Centre 'Piero Fanti'
communication.coordinates_basis: source (41 58 41.7 N, 13 36 06.2 E); altitude of the Fucino plain, approximate
communication.bands_basis: teleport with about 170 antennas (control of COSMO-SkyMed, Meteosat / MTG, Galileo control centre); bands not listed in the sources
communication.status_evidence: Wikipedia: the largest civil teleport in the world, controls satellites (COSMO-SkyMed, MTG), tracked Orion of Artemis II in 2026; FOC-1A antenna modernised under a February 2026 ASI-Telespazio agreement

communication.name: Lario - Telespazio Space Centre (Gera Lario)
communication.coordinates_basis: locality: Pian di Spagna, Gera Lario (CO); altitude approximate
communication.bands_basis: 40 transmitting and 20 receiving antennas, main dish Lario 1 (32 m) for geostationary satellites; bands not listed in the sources
communication.status_evidence: in service since 1977; World Teleport Association level 4 certification (October 2023)

communication.name: Scanzano - Telespazio Space Centre (Piana degli Albanesi, Sicily)
communication.coordinates_basis: locality: Lago Scanzano, next to which the centre stands (source); altitude 'circa 500 m' of the area
communication.bands_basis: satellite telecommunications teleport (OneWeb hosting since 2019); bands not listed in the sources
communication.status_evidence: operational since 1989 (Wikipedia); hosting services for OneWeb since 2019 (third-party directory)
communication.note: Not Scanzano Jonico (Basilicata): the Telespazio centre is in Sicily.

communication.name: Rome - Sapienza School of Aerospace Engineering ground station
communication.coordinates_basis: Via Salaria 851, Rome: the site of the S5Lab telescopes in END-010 stations.json (RESDOS, MITO)
communication.bands_basis: Yagi-Uda VHF/UHF antennas (telecommand uplink, telemetry) and an S-band section with a 4 m dish
communication.status_evidence: the station page says it is currently used to operate the Tigrisat satellite (page not dated)

communication.name: Viterbo - Universita della Tuscia ground station (HORTA)
communication.coordinates_basis: locality: Viterbo (the station is on building F of the Riello campus); altitude approximate
communication.bands_basis: VHF and UHF uplink / downlink, S-band downlink only (up to 1 Mbps)
communication.status_evidence: built in 2019 (HORTA project); primary ground station of the CUSP CubeSat mission in the 2022 and 2025 mission papers

optical.name: Matera - SPADE (ASI Centro di Geodesia Spaziale)
optical.status_evidence: observer of the END-010 light-curve module (S5Lab network); the site hosts the MLRO laser ranging telescope

optical.name: Collepardo - SCUDO
optical.status_evidence: observer of the END-010 light-curve module (S5Lab network)

optical.name: Rome - S5Lab RESDOS / MITO (Via Salaria)
optical.status_evidence: observers of the END-010 light-curve module (S5Lab network); urban sky

optical.name: Rome - EDUSCOPE
optical.status_evidence: observer of the END-010 light-curve module; urban sky

optical.status_evidence: observer of the END-010 light-curve module
